tower_gatling.name: Ki Blast Turret
tower_gatling.description: Rapid-fire ki blast emitter. Cheap and relentless, perfect for holding the line against weak invaders.

tower_cannon.name: Kamehameha Cannon
tower_cannon.description: Wide energy wave emitter. Devastating at choke points where invaders cluster together.

tower_frost.name: Solar Flare
tower_frost.description: Blinding light crystal that slows enemies with searing radiance. Gives defenders time to regroup.

tower_poison.name: Hellzone Grenade
tower_poison.description: Energy sphere cluster that inflicts lingering damage on enemies. The corruption spreads, ignoring armor.

tower_sniper.name: Special Beam Cannon
tower_sniper.description: Thin piercing beam that strikes the strongest enemies from afar. Armor-piercing and far-reaching, hits ground and air.

tower_aura.name: Kaioken Aura
tower_aura.description: Pulsing red aura that empowers nearby towers with enhanced damage, range, and fire rate.

tower_economy.name: Capsule Corp Generator
tower_economy.description: A Capsule Corporation device that generates a steady stream of Zeni for Earth's defense.

enemy_runner.name: Saibaman
enemy_runner.description: A small, fast creature grown from seeds. Fragile but quick — don't let it slip through.

enemy_grunt.name: Frieza Soldier
enemy_grunt.description: A rank-and-file soldier in battle armor. Balanced threat that forms the core of every assault.

enemy_armored.name: Android
enemy_armored.description: A metallic humanoid with heavy plating. Reduces incoming damage by half unless struck with armor-piercing weapons.

enemy_flyer.name: Flying Saibaman
enemy_flyer.description: A winged Saibaman that soars above ground defenses. Only towers with anti-air can strike it from the sky.

enemy_swarm.name: Cell Junior
enemy_swarm.description: A small purple creature that spawns in overwhelming numbers. Each individual is weak, but their horde can break through.

enemy_boss.name: Demon King
enemy_boss.description: A towering villain leading the assault on Earth. Massive HP, thick armor, and a bounty of Zeni for whoever fells it.

map_single_path.name: Snake Way
map_single_path.description: The winding path of the afterlife. Master your defense on this serpentine road.

map_multi_path.name: Planet Namek
map_multi_path.description: Two approaches converge on a single point. Split your defenses wisely — both lanes demand attention.

map_branching.name: Cell Games Arena
map_branching.description: One path forks and rejoins. Choose to funnel enemies at the merge or defend each branch independently.

title.title: Don't Let the Villains Destroy Earth!
title.subtitle: A Dragon Ball Z Tower Defense Game
